project.title: 旅店交钥匙
project.purpose: 忠实呈现交接与礼貌回应

sources.excerpt: 旧式旅店里，店主把钥匙推给旅人。旅人接住，说“谢谢”。

style.rationale: 平衡双人空间证明钥匙交接，暖灯不掩盖手。

assets.state_description: 棕背心短发成年店主；尚无图
assets.design_prompt_en: Character design sheet of an original middle-aged innkeeper with short dark hair, a plain brown waistcoat over a cream shirt, dark trousers. Front and three-quarter views, neutral stance, soft even light, photographic reference style. Aspect ratio 16:9.
assets.design_notes_zh: 固定棕背心与米色衬衫，不含品牌与原片角色。

assets.state_description: 灰外套成年旅人；尚无图
assets.design_prompt_en: Character design sheet of an original adult traveler with short wavy hair, a plain grey coat and dark trousers. Front and three-quarter views, hands visible, neutral background, even soft light, photographic reference style. Aspect ratio 16:9.
assets.design_notes_zh: 固定灰外套轮廓与短卷发。

assets.state_description: 北柜台、东门、西侧机位、柜台后暖灯
assets.design_prompt_en: Empty fictional old inn interior, dark wooden counter along the north wall, entrance on the east, a shaded warm lamp behind the counter. View from the west side, room depth readable, no people, no lettering. Photographic environment plate. Aspect ratio 16:9.
assets.design_notes_zh: 灯和门位置必须可读，不暗示真实年代史料。

assets.state_description: 钥匙在店主右手旁，旅人尚未接

assets.rights: 依原创基准图与接受结果制作
assets.state_description: 预案：钥匙在旅人左手，需CL001实际结果核对

scenes.geography: 北柜台，店主在后，旅人在南侧；东入口；摄影机在西侧，两人连线同侧。
scenes.intent: 完成钥匙归属从店主到旅人的变化

shots.reason: 双人中景保留双方手与钥匙路线
shots.start_state: 店主画左，旅人画右，钥匙在店主右手旁
shots.end_state: 钥匙进入旅人左手，两人仍隔柜台

contract.perspective: 平视标准透视，手与脸均清楚
contract.composition: 店主左、旅人右，柜台前景
contract.lighting: 柜台后暖灯照双手，东门背景略冷
contract.blocking: 店主右手推，旅人左手接，脚不换位
contract.fragile: 钥匙数量、持物手与接触

shots.edit_relation: 开场交代双方；在旅人接住后切其回应
shots.rejected_option: 不采用只拍店主脸的特写，它无法证明钥匙交接

shots.audience_task: 把谢谢与刚完成交接的旅人对应
shots.reason: 中近景读回应，同时留下持钥匙的左手
shots.start_state: 预案：旅人左手握钥匙，目光低垂
shots.end_state: 旅人看店主，说完谢谢，钥匙仍在左手

contract.perspective: 平视，脸与左手同一可读范围
contract.composition: 旅人偏右，店主肩膀虚化在左前景
contract.lighting: 继承暖灯与略冷东门背景
contract.blocking: 旅人抬眼对店主说话，不移步

shots.edit_relation: 接上握钥匙末态，不重演接钥匙

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Using the innkeeper from image 1, traveler from image 2, and room geography from image 3, create a photographic balanced medium two-shot from the west side of the counter. Brown-waistcoated innkeeper at frame left, grey-coated traveler at right. One brass key lies beside the innkeeper's right hand. Warm shaded lamp lights both hands; cool doorway beyond. Aspect ratio 16:9.
keyframes.image_prompt_zh: 生图顺序1店主、2旅人、3环境；西侧双人中景，钥匙仍在店主侧，暖灯照手。

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Using the innkeeper from image 1, traveler from image 2, and room from image 3, create a photographic medium-close view of the grey-coated traveler from the same west side of the counter. The traveler's left hand holds one brass key, eyes lowered before speaking. Innkeeper's brown shoulder at left foreground, same warm lamp and cool doorway. Aspect ratio 16:9.
keyframes.image_prompt_zh: 第二镜预案，同侧中近景，旅人左手已握钥匙；CL001接受后按真实末态修订，不能当作已观察尾帧。

clips.video_prompt_zh: @图片1 参考两人身份、服装、柜台布局与灯光。0–4秒：固定双人中景，画左店主右手把一把钥匙推给画右旅人。4–8秒：旅人左手接住，手留在柜台上；本段尚不说话。保持同侧机位与暖灯，只有金属擦木声和室内底噪，无配乐，不复制钥匙。
clips.fallback: 接触不清时拆推与接两镜，仍保留物件归属变化。

clips.video_prompt_zh: @图片1 参考旅人身份、左手握钥匙的状态和旅店光线。0–3秒：同侧固定中近景，旅人抬眼看向左前景的店主，说“谢谢”。3–6秒：说完停住，钥匙仍在左手，不再发生交接。保留室内底噪，无配乐，不加其他台词。
clips.fallback: CL001实际末态不符时先修订本镜起始帧；不得从失败片段直接接续。

issues.suggestion: 接受CL001后核对真实持物、机位和声场再定稿
